title: Robichaux band and Susquehanna lake excursion boat
summary: Played Saturdays at the country club and ran dance excursions on the Susquehanna across the lake from West End.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I only had them little yearly books and put it on every day. They had to do that to keep them being confused. Sure. Otherwise, we were getting so many jobs that if you didn't have them on the book, you were, you get a job like you're playing now, you get a job for next week sometime where you're marked at. You get a job like that, you see? Then I would mark the price what I'd get for a two. I don't know. I played with Robichaux. Now we used to play at the country club on Saturday night. On Sundays, we'd get on a boat, we'd call the Susquehanna. We would go over the manoeuvre, over the lake. We'd just take them over there and we'd hang around all day and just bring them back.
You'd play on the boat over there too or just on the boat?
Just on the boat. Just on the boat. We'd be free to loaf around.
You'd have dancing on the boat too?

Oh yeah. Then we had, through the week we had excursions on the lake on the same boat. I just remember what night, but it was two nights we used to have excursions on the Susquehanna. Way out there, it was just as cool out there on the lake. Way out on the lake you could see the lights, you know, the guard light.
How long did it take the boat to get across the lake then?

It was about an hour, an hour and a half at that time. One hour and a half, you could say one hour, it was pretty fast. Yeah, fast. And we used to play out on the, every night on the, go out on an excursion and play. And come in, come back and you could hear the band playing at the night clubs after we'd get back, you see. And you could hear us, used to have a band near where the boat landed called...
Where did that land, at West End or Spanish Fort, about where?

Uh huh, used to leave from West End. And, uh, had a band. It had, different places have three or four pieces band in it. You know, it was, always was nice out there. And they used to have the hour band, or that was a big band like ours. They used to, used to be playing in a club out there too. And when we'd be coming, coming home or coming along after we'd get off the boat, we could hear them playing. It's a good band too.
